headline_cluster.headline: היממה הראשונה של GTA 6: יותר מ–19 מיליון עותקים נמכרו, וזו רק ההתחלה
headline_cluster.note: Paywalled; only lead/opening visible via WebFetch. Sales figures attributed to market research firm Sensor Tower, NOT a Take-Two press release (article states Take-Two had not yet published official sales data). ~19.1M copies sold through Thursday (incl. pre-orders); ~$1.84B revenue per Sensor Tower; 125M hours of stream viewing on day one.

headline_cluster.headline: העולם בטירוף: הביקורות על GTA החדש והשיא שנשבר - יהיו אנשים מחוץ לבית בסוף השבוע? "זינוק של 45%"
headline_cluster.note: Body summary extracted via WebFetch. The 45% figure is Partner (Israeli telecom) CDN content-consumption traffic, not searches/bookings/sales. Also cites: Metacritic 99/100 (ties Ocarina of Time record); IGN/GameSpot 10/10; PeakMetrics social sentiment 54.5% positive/45.5% negative among posts with a clear stance, performance-complaint discussion up 55x on launch day; Bezeq domestic traffic +~30% (vs. a prior +30% surge during 'Roaring Lion' operation week one), international traffic +~50%; Partner also reports a jump in PlayStation devices connecting pre-launch.
